headline: The Linear Representation Hypothesis survives to 2026: on Qwen3.5-9B-Base the causal inner product stays 1.27x more orthogonal than Euclidean (gemma-4-12B 1.38x), all binary single-token concepts stay linear, and the advantage still clusters by model family, not scale or year.

metrics.label: Causal orthogonality advantage (Euclid/causal ratio, all 27), Qwen3.5-9B-Base (2026)
metrics.note: Still >1 (causal more orthogonal); lands in the Qwen family band 1.25-1.31, below the paper's 1.5-2.5x band. gemma-4-12B: 1.38x.

metrics.label: Causal off-diagonal mean (approx orthogonality), all 27, 2026 models
metrics.note: Concepts stay approximately orthogonal under the causal metric on both 2026 models.

metrics.label: Concepts with linear subspace (Cohen's d>=1), 2026 models
metrics.note: Both 2026 models separate every viable concept, including thing=>part; subspace claim survives.

metrics.label: Family-not-scale: 2026 Qwen3.5 (9B) vs Qwen band
metrics.note: Advantage tracks family, not year or scale: Qwen stays ~1.25-1.31 across 2024->2026 and 7.6B->9B.

metrics.label: C11 uncorrelatedness r (separable vs non-separable) + C8 king->queen flip, 2026 models
metrics.baseline: small vs correlated; flips by alpha=0.2
metrics.note: Both sanity checks hold on both 2026 models.

tables.title: 2026 refresh vs the prior ladder (all-27 concepts; this session + reused 001 values)

figures.caption: Did it survive to 2026? Top: mean off-diagonal |inner product| (0 = perfectly orthogonal) for the causal (solid blue) vs Euclidean (dashed orange) inner product across 7 base models 2023-2026, on the 22 concepts viable in all 7; the causal line stays clearly below Euclidean everywhere (ratio annotated). The two 2026 models (ringed red, shaded) keep the same ordering. The 2023 point matches the on-disk replication (0.046/0.069 causal/Euclid, all-27). Bottom: fraction of concepts with a linear subspace (Cohen's d>=1) - 22/22 for every model except Llama-2 (21/22).
figures.alt: Two-panel figure. Top line chart: orange dashed Euclidean line above blue solid causal line across seven models; the two rightmost (2026) points are circled in red inside a shaded region, causal ~0.052-0.069, Euclidean ~0.067-0.089. Bottom bar chart: subspace fraction 21/22 for Llama-2 and 22/22 for the other six models, the two 2026 bars in orange.

figures.caption: Family, not scale or year. All-27 causal-orthogonality advantage (Euclid/causal ratio) per model vs release year, colored by family with per-family mean bands. The 2026 refresh models are ringed black. Qwen3.5-9B (2026, 9B) lands at 1.27, inside the Qwen band (1.25-1.31) set by Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 despite being newer and larger; the LLaMA lineage sits at ~1.5x and gemma-4 forms a new family point at 1.38. The paper's 1.5-2.5x band is shaded.
figures.alt: Scatter of ratio (y, 1.0-2.6) vs release year (x, 2023-2026). Blue LLaMA circles near 1.5; orange Qwen squares near 1.25-1.31 including the black-ringed 2026 Qwen3.5 at 1.27; green OLMo triangle at 1.25; pink Gemma diamond (black-ringed) at 1.38. Dashed per-family mean lines; grey shaded 1.5-2.5 band at top.

notes: Every 2026 number computed this session from each model's own unembedding matrix via AutoModelForImageTextToText + get_output_embeddings; the 2023-2025 baselines are reused verbatim from study 001's on-disk results, and the 2023 anchor is read from the replication artifacts (Llama-2 recomputed in 001 reproduces 0.046/0.069 exactly).

2026 loading-recipe correction: the text decoder is at m.model.language_model (not m.language_model) for both Qwen3.5 and gemma-4; this affected only the optional C8 hook path, not the LRH core. Both 2026 models loaded, forwarded, and hooked - neither was descoped.
gemma-4-12B (base) added as a second 2026 point (fully downloaded and hookable); its embeddings are tied, and LRH uses the unembedding (= the tied weight).

The paper's quantitative 1.5-2.5x band is not met by the 2026 models (Qwen3.5 1.27, gemma-4 1.38) - the effect persists (ratio>1, low absolute off-diagonal) but is weaker outside LLaMA, reinforcing the family-not-scale reading.
22-concept apples-to-apples intersection unchanged from study 001 (Llama-2's tokenizer is the binding constraint); both 2026 models are individually 26/27-viable.
